mode: Built-in image_gen edits; one call per bird; user-requested vibrancy revision. Original target plus both inspected live references supplied.

prompts.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather and style-transfer. REVISION requested by the user, not a new composition. Image 1 is the current target bird painting to revise. Image 2 is the ACTUAL LIVE GREAT SPOTTED WOODPECKER CARD, the user's preferred reference for vibrant manga colour, crisp graphic readability and luminous woodland. Image 3 is the ACTUAL LIVE TREECREEPER CARD, reference for coherent integrated scenes and bird-specific outfits. The current target is too dark, brown and visually busy at small card size. Revise it decisively: use the woodpecker's luminous mint/turquoise and fresh spring-green forest depth, cleaner intentional manga ink contours, graphic cel-shaded colour shapes, vivid local species colours, bright eye/face highlights and clear silhouette separation. Reduce background fine-detail clutter and sepia/brown cast. Put a softly luminous, lighter, simpler area behind the bird's silhouette; keep dark ink and selective rich shadows ON the bird for readable contrast, not uniformly washed-out exposure. Foreground bird must be obvious and attractive at 180px thumbnail width. Keep a richly drawn full scene with the bird naturally on its branch, same perspective and shared lighting; NO pasted cutout, no white halo/outline, no flat blank background. Retain the species identity, natural markings, ordinary proportions, two feathered wings, two legs/feet and no human arms/hands/fingers/extra limbs. Preserve the target's species-specific costume details and full head/feet/tail inside the square. No text, border, logo or watermark. Both reference cards remain unchanged. Keep this Eurasian Blue Tit's clear cobalt/azure crown and wings, white cheek and dark eye-stripe, lemon-yellow breast and lightweight BLUE orchard-scout cape with blossom clasp and sheathed blade. Spring blossom branch remains; distant scenery simplified into luminous mint/green woodland and blue sky. Make the blue and yellow bird and cape boldly readable, not brown or grey. The blue cap must not turn black; no broad Great Tit belly stripe.

Use case: lighting-weather and style-transfer. Revise Image 1, the Long-tailed Tit card. Image 2 is the ACTUAL CURRENT Great Spotted Woodpecker card, the user's vivid manga colour/readability reference. Image 3 is the current Treecreeper, reference for integrated species-specific costume design. The target is too subdued, brown and fussy at thumbnail size. Make it substantially brighter and more vibrant like the woodpecker: luminous cool mint/teal forest depth, fresh green lichen/moss, clean white blossoms, crisp black ink contours and graphic manga cel-shading. Simplify detailed background twigs/flowers directly behind the bird so its whole silhouette is distinct; preserve dark outlines and rich selective shadows on the bird, never wash out everything. Keep Long-tailed Tit's brilliant soft-white face/body, black head-side stripes and wings, stronger but natural rose-pink flanks/shoulders, tiny stubby beak, and unmistakably very long slender black-and-white tail. Use case: lighting-weather and style-transfer. Revise Image 1, the GOLDCREST card. Image 2 is the ACTUAL CURRENT Great Spotted Woodpecker, the user's reference for vibrant manga colour, luminous woodland and clear small-card readability. Image 3 is Treecreeper, reference for integrated composition and species-specific outfits. The user says the target is too dark, brown and hard to see. Make it clearly brighter, fresher and much more visibly manga: clean expressive ink contours, deliberate cel-shaded colour shapes, luminous mint/teal conifer forest, vivid fresh green needles, pale cream face and bright true GOLD crown with black edging. Replace the muddy sepia atmosphere with airy green light and cool forest depth. Simplify fine background detail near the silhouette and put a softer lighter opening behind the bird; preserve crisp dark feather outlines and selective shadows for strong foreground contrast, no washed-out exposure. Make the tiny round Goldcrest unmistakable and compelling at 180px width. Keep olive-green back, cream/grey underside, dark round eye with pale ring but no bold white eyebrow, tiny pointed dark beak, pale wingbars and short tail. Retain the lightweight moss-green cloak with pine-needle embroidery and golden trim, amber clasp and sheathed blade; outfit unique to a tiny conifer-canopy explorer, natural crest exposed. Keep the existing pose on mossy branch, full head/crest/feet/tail within square margins and rich coherent illustrated spruce canopy with cones. Ordinary bird anatomy: two feathered wings, two scaly legs/feet, no human arms/hands/fingers, no extra limbs or human torso. Integrated scene with matching ink/lighting on bird and world, no pasted cutout, no white halo, no flat background, no photorealism, no chibi. No text, border, watermark or logo.
